title: HexGL
tagline: Hover-ship racing through a neon city. Three laps, don't clip the walls.
blurb: This is my favorite kind of racing game: a hover ship, a neon city track and a timer. Hold the up arrow to go, steer with the arrows, and use A and D to air-brake through the tight corners.
desc: HexGL, the free WebGL hover-racing game by Thibaut Despoulain. Race three laps through a neon city in your browser.
author: Thibaut Despoulain (BKcore)
extraCredit: A few of its source files carry the author's older CC BY-NC 3.0 header, so this page has no ads and never will.
controls: Touch: left half steers, hold the right half to go
tags: racing hover ship webgl neon track laps
